entity.name: Volocopter NEOM Flight & $175M Investment
entity.meta_description: NEOM invested $175M in Volocopter (Nov 2022) with 15-aircraft order and GACA-authorized flight 21 June 2023. Volocopter filed insolvency 26 Dec 2024; acquired by Wanfeng/Diamond Aircraft March 2025 for €10M.
